story.en: TODO(verify): The image leaves Danlugan ni Ina on a pagoda barge and follows the Naga River toward the Peñafrancia Basilica. Danlugan departure and the concluding Mass are sourced; the river path, formation and 210-minute duration are illustrative. The simulation retains the original usual-afternoon window 15:00–18:30 and following 18:30 Mass by owner choice. The updated 2026 advisory instead moved boarding/start to 21:00 and estimated Mass at 23:00; this is not the final actual 2026 schedule.
